### Outputs

#### ReserveStockResult

Wrapper for the two ZFL responses of reserveStock (ZDL has no union return type). Exactly one of `reserved` / `unavailable` is set, according to `outcome`.

| outcome | [ReserveStockOutcome](#reservestockoutcome) |  |
